generationInputs.prompt: An overhead shot displays a collection of printable tarot journal pages and a bound journal, all neatly arranged on a textured, light brown surface that mimics a rustic wooden table. At the top, slightly overlapping the bound journal and other pages, is a page with a dark beige border and the words "Tarot Journal" in a stylized, dark brown serif font. Below this title, an illustration shows a pale-toned hand holding three tarot cards with geometric and celestial designs in beige and brown. Surrounding this central page are various other printable sheets, each featuring different layouts for tarot readings and journaling. To the left, a page titled "The Empress" displays text and a small, colorful illustration of a figure with a crown and scepter. Below it, another page labeled "Card of the Day" offers sections for the date, focus, and daily intentions. Further left, edges of other pages hint at sections for "Decision-Making" and possibly other tarot spreads. To the right of the central "Tarot Journal" page, a sheet for a "Manifestation Spread" has boxes for card placements and text prompts. Below it, a page titled "Intention Spread" also shows designated areas for cards and notes. The edges of more pages are visible on the far right, suggesting a comprehensive set of journaling templates. Above these arranged items, the words "TAROT" are prominently displayed in a large, decorative, dark brown serif font. Below it, "JOURNAL AND GUIDEBOOK" is written in a smaller, clean, dark brown sans-serif font. Underneath, smaller text reads "190 Page Bundle | Printable | US Letter". The lighting appears to be soft and even, casting minimal shadows and highlighting the textures of the pages and the surface beneath.
